create.name: Jamie Butler
create.bio:
Jamie Butler is a medium, trance channeller and Reiki teacher who calls herself the Everyday Medium. She says she has seen energy around people and heard spirit voices since childhood, and she has given readings in public since the early 1990s. After a fine arts degree at the University of Florida she trained as a Reiki Master and in massage, later adding hypnotherapy and a past-life regression programme with Brian Weiss, before settling in Atlanta, where she still lives.

In 2001 she set up her company, Love and Light, and in 2011 opened The Center for Love and Light in Atlanta, which hosts visiting teachers as well as her own work. Her teaching centres on perceiving and reading subtle light energy: her own aura-reading classes run alongside a self-paced seven-module course with The Shift Network that uses colour cards, emotions and the chakras to decode intuitive impressions. She also runs Reiki attunements up to Master level, remote Reiki series, public channelling sessions and group trips abroad, and keeps a long-running YouTube channel of short talks, guided meditations and monthly support groups for healers and channellers. Her first book, With Love and Light, tells the story of growing up with her abilities.
